ننتق (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِ (nantaqi) /nan.ta.qi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# نُنْتَقَ (nuntaqa) /nun.ta.qa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
